ai.title: Find hope during AI disruptions
ai.description: ARTIFICIAL intelligence (AI) is controversial. Many see the promises and perils of AI. Will AI save the world or destroy the world? Like the industrial progress from the introduction of the printing press, electricity, cars and airplanes, AI brings the excitement of technological advancement and the anxiety of the unknown future. Yet, both good and bad effects depend on the intent of the developers and users. If you are beneficiaries of medical research that cures illnesses, a corporation that has achieved increased revenues and production because of efficiency, a farmer who increased production due to predictability of weather, or an entrepreneur who quickly developed your creative website, branding and marketing strategy from available data, then there is much to be thankful for.
